entity.summary: Centralized cryptocurrency exchange launched in 2019 and currently operating with temporary deposit and withdrawal restrictions during a custody-infrastructure upgrade.
entity.notes: The current first-party platform remains reachable and identifies Coinlocally LLC in Yerevan, Armenia. A current first-party notice states that custody, deposit, and withdrawal infrastructure is being upgraded and that deposits and withdrawals are temporarily suspended without a stated completion time. HEI therefore uses limited rather than active or dead. Independent exchange-directory material reports a 2019 launch year; January 1 is used only as a year-level marker. Later international operating or licensing claims are not treated as a resolved replacement legal lineage in this record.

evidence.title: Coinlocally platform and infrastructure-upgrade notice
evidence.notes: The current first-party platform remains available but states that deposits and withdrawals are temporarily suspended while custody and transfer infrastructure is upgraded.

evidence.title: Coinlocally exchange profile
evidence.notes: Independent exchange-directory material identifies Coinlocally as a centralized exchange launched in 2019. HEI does not rely on directory licensing claims to resolve the current legal operator.
